Bill.BriefDescription: Convening a working conference on enhancing marketing opportunities for local agricultural products.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to convening a conference on enhancing marketingopportunities for local agricultural products; and creating a newsection.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BillSection.RCWSLText: (1) Washington State University, incooperation with the department of agriculture and the department ofcommunity, trade, and economic development, shall host a workingconference to explore the opportunities and impediments to increasinglocal markets for locally produced food products and local agriculturalproducers. The objective of the conference shall be to develop astrategic plan and specific implementing actions that will assist localproducers to meet the preferences of local consumers of food products. (2) The following, at a minimum, shall be included as topics of theconference: (a) Issues of concern to local livestock producers and localconsumers in making locally produced meat products more available tolocal consumers, including a discussion of concepts such as a statemeat inspection program and a mobile livestock slaughtering unit as a p. 1 SB 6956means to expand marketing opportunities for local producers andconsumers; (b) Issues of concern to local fruit and vegetable growers andlocal consumers in making locally grown fruit and vegetables moreavailable to local consumers; (c) Ways to enhance farm-to-market connections that aid inenhancing the viability of local agricultural producers and reducingthe distance that agricultural products are transported; (d) An examination of alternative ways to define and rewardsustainable production of agricultural products; (e) A consideration of emerging interests of growing urbanpopulations in nearby agritourism and agricultural-related experiencesfor students and adults, and an evaluation of how Washington state cancapitalize on this emerging trend; and (f) A means of informing farmers about opportunities and proceduresfor supplying state agencies and local school districts to supplyWashington grown farm products as a result of the local farms healthykids act, chapter . . . (Second Substitute Senate Bill No. 6483), Lawsof 2008. (3) The conference shall be scheduled at a time that will allowsufficient time to prepare a summary of the conference proceedings.The conference proceedings shall include a summary of the topics thatare discussed, and findings and recommendations of the conferenceparticipants. The report shall be submitted to the appropriatecommittees of the legislature by December 1, 2010.
